title: Maximum Subarray
statement_short: Given an integer array nums, find the contiguous subarray containing at least one number which has the largest sum and return its sum.
hint: Array size up to 10^5 requires an O(n) single pass, keeping or resetting the running sum dynamically.
why_not: Right: 1D DP (Kadane's algorithm) maintains current max ending at each index by taking max(num, current + num) in O(n) time and O(1) space. Not Sliding Window: Negative numbers prevent expanding or shrinking window boundaries monotonically. Not Two Pointers: Scanning pointer pairs from ends cannot locate arbitrary contiguous max sum subsegments efficiently. Not Prefix Sum: Computing prefix sums requires an auxiliary O(n) pass or nested index min tracking.
